problem: Which set is equivalent to $B={x\in R:{x}^{2}-5=0}?$
worked_solution:
The elements of the given set are real numbers that satisfy the equation ${x}^{2}-5=0.$

So, we first need to solve our equation for $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}-5 & =0 \\ {x}^{2} & =5 \\ x & =\pm \sqrt{5}\end{aligned}
$$

The solutions are $x=-\sqrt{5},\sqrt{5},$ and both of these solutions are real numbers.

Therefore, we can write the given set as

$$
B={\pm \sqrt{5}}.
$$
